metadata.title: Hour-Aware Adaptive Risk Management for Autonomous Memecoin Trading: Companion Dataset + Manuscript Bundle
metadata.description:
Hour-Aware Adaptive Risk Management for Autonomous Memecoin Trading: Companion Dataset + Manuscript Bundle (v1.3)

Kamat, Arati Uday. Independent Researcher. ORCID 0009-0000-4781-312X.

Companion deposit for Kamat (2026), a 15-day paper-traded deployment of an autonomous memecoin trading system on Solana decentralised exchanges. The bundle contains the exact data underlying the paper's headline results (190 closed paper-trades and 4,874 post-rejection price samples), four supporting figures (SVG), and the v4 manuscript (Markdown source, HTML and PDF).

v1.3 (2026-09-28) removes patent application numbers from the manuscript files and the documentation, replacing each with "a pending U.S. provisional patent application", and removes submission-status details from the documentation. Data files, figures and the reproduction script are byte-identical to v1.2. See CHANGELOG_v1.2_to_v1.3.md.

v1.2 (2026-08-03) corrected the manuscript files that shipped in v1.1 (2026-07-27), which contained an intermediate v4 build rather than the final v4 build completed 2026-07-29. See CHANGELOG_v1.1_to_v1.2.md.

Contents:
- data/trades.csv (190 rows, 7 columns): closed paper-trades over 29 March - 12 April 2026 UTC.
- data/rejection_outcomes.csv (4,874 rows): post-rejection follow-up price samples across six anonymised filter categories.
- data/scanner_2026-04-09.csv + scanner_2026-04-10.csv: two days of paired scanner observation logs.
- figures/: four SVG figures (architecture, PnL by hour, equity curve, filter effectiveness).
- manuscript/: v4 Markdown source, HTML rendering and PDF.
- audit.py: reproduction script that prints every headline number from the deposited CSVs.
- PROVENANCE.md: per-filter event and sample counts.
- README, LICENSE (CC-BY-4.0), checksums, changelogs.

Change from v1.0: the exitReason column of trades.csv is removed in v1.1 (it embedded per-tier threshold values that are the subject of a pending U.S. provisional patent application); the seven remaining columns are cell-for-cell identical to v1.0. The three other data files are byte-identical to v1.0. All headline numbers in the manuscript reproduce from the v1.1 files by direct arithmetic; audit.py verifies this. The v1.0 record remains permanently archived under its own version DOI (10.5281/zenodo.20043302), as with any Zenodo version.

DOIs: concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20043301 resolves to the latest published version; v1.0 version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20043302 is the permanent identifier for the original 2026-05-05 unredacted deposit; v1.1 version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21636182; v1.2 version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21780072 (superseded by v1.3); the v1.3 version DOI is assigned by Zenodo on publication of this version.

Companion preprints: SSRN 6564803, arXiv 2606.08232.

Competing interests: the trading system is the subject of a pending U.S. provisional patent application (filed 2026-06-25, Micro Entity). Data and manuscript releases do not restrict re-use under the deposit's CC-BY-4.0 licence.

Keywords: autonomous trading, memecoin, decentralised exchange, market microstructure, time-of-day effects, counterfactual evaluation, reject inference, fragility, Solana.

JEL: G11, G12, G14, G17.
